slice_f_observations.repeated_per_call: JsonSchemaSemanticValidator.validate() calls check_schema and constructs a validator on every call, so preparation is paid per validation for an unchanged schema.

synthetic_speed_sensitivity.interpretation: MAY DISQUALIFY a candidate as fragile; MUST NOT QUALIFY one. Surviving synthetic scaling is not machine independence.

feature_definitions.array_constraints: Count of array-shaping keywords (items, contains, minItems, ...).
feature_definitions.bytes: Length of the canonical (sorted-key, separator-tight) serialisation.
feature_definitions.combinator_product: Product of every combinator's branch count, capped at 10**9. An *approximate* worst-case expansion, not an evaluation count: real evaluators short-circuit anyOf and do not expand allOf combinatorially.
feature_definitions.enum_values: Total enum members summed across every 'enum' clause.
feature_definitions.max_combinator_breadth: Largest branch count in any single combinator clause.
feature_definitions.max_combinator_depth: Deepest nesting of combinators inside combinators.
feature_definitions.max_depth: Deepest nested mapping level reachable from the root.
feature_definitions.nodes: Total schema nodes, counted as in Slice A/B so the two agree.
feature_definitions.prefix_items: Number of 'prefixItems' entries summed across the document.
feature_definitions.properties: Total declared properties across every 'properties' map.
feature_definitions.ref_graph_depth: Longest chain of $ref-to-$ref hops resolvable inside the document. 0 when no reference target itself contains a reference.
feature_definitions.refs: Total '$ref' occurrences, including repeats of one target.
feature_definitions.repeated_refs: refs minus distinct_ref_targets: how much reuse the graph has.
feature_definitions.semantic_keywords: Count of keywords a semantic evaluator (not the rule engine) executes.

measured_quantity_note: semantic_evaluator_total = semantic preparation + payload evaluation + semantic-validator-local orchestration.
